review_description: Have had the service for only two months, it's just myself and wife living at the house. I work full time and rarely at home. First months bill was slightly over $200 and the second month bill was almost $300, this is based on only one person being home. They couldn't provide an explanation except we're using the same amount as a family of four people. Too many other companies out there for options, stay clear of these guys!!

I am still in the process of getting approvals through before installation can commence. I found the information you supplied invaluable in selecting an installer and which products to have installed.Thank you.
